decision.reason: [ev-d35ac549b565] is a one-line changelog entry. It only says that commit bfd72b42 reverts an earlier fix for a race condition in initial sharding (#22264), and it points to PRs #22354/#22264. It doesn't name the component or setting involved, say why the fix was reverted, say which environments are affected (for example, sharded controller setups), or say what happens to an environment whose operator does nothing. The PR descriptions or diffs would be needed to write the subject, applicability and consequence.
